cv=$(cargo --version); rv=$(rustc --version); cc=$(cargo clippy --version)
case "$cv" in *1.98.1*) ;; *) echo "PIN FAIL cargo: $cv"; exit 1;; esac
case "$rv" in *1.98.1*) ;; *) echo "PIN FAIL rustc: $rv"; exit 1;; esac
case "$cc" in *0.1.98*) ;; *) echo "PIN FAIL clippy: $cc"; exit 1;; esac
echo "PIN OK: $cv | $rv | $cc"

GW="${PACKET_WORKTREE:?export PACKET_WORKTREE to the ticket worktree}"
TOM=d5e06fd03f6bedf7827bd6ce2e3f47b1f5ce1972ecfdec8e8301046555e469d4; LOK=141ae6c07c7de738619e584de7ee1f96f9fc147a05864c15313a33e474574cfb

  gt=$(git -C "$GW" cat-file blob "$R:Cargo.toml" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
  gl=$(git -C "$GW" cat-file blob "$R:Cargo.lock" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
